radionuclide.record_grain: One nuclide identity and versioned physical reference description, including stable daughters.

decay_emission.record_grain: One decay branch or one emission component with a specified energy definition and yield.

molecular_entity.record_grain: One chemically specified substance or molecular component, independent of commercial packaging.

biological_target.record_grain: One biological target identity; expression, binding and internalization are contextual evidence records.

medicinal_product.record_grain: One versioned commercial or investigational medicinal-product formulation, distinct from agent, authorization and batch.

product_ingredient.record_grain: One ingredient role and quantity specification in a medicinal-product formulation.

product_package.record_grain: One versioned package specification for a medicinal product, not a physical vial.

package_component.record_grain: One containment relationship between two package specifications.

regulatory_authorization.record_grain: One product-specific regulatory application or authorization state in one jurisdiction at a stated date.

supply_offer.record_grain: One dated commercial supply presentation or catalog offer; not a clinical prescription.

material_lot.record_grain: One physical lot of a precursor, radionuclide stock or other manufacturing material.

preparation_event.record_grain: One actual production, compounding, reconstitution or dilution event with specified inputs and output batch.

radiopharmaceutical_unit.record_grain: One physical vial, syringe or other traceable unit from a batch at a stated calibration time.

radiopharmaceutical_order.record_grain: One procurement request or patient-specific prescription, explicitly distinguished by order_kind.

dispense_event.record_grain: One patient-specific dispensing event allocating a traceable physical unit to a prescription.

reference_evidence.record_grain: One citable evidence context, population or experimental dataset; not an individual patient observation.

computational_model.record_grain: One versioned computational model specification, independent of any execution or prediction.

model_run.record_grain: One recorded execution of a computational model with explicit inputs and information cutoff.

model_parameter.record_grain: One parameter value or distribution for a model specification or execution, with units and provenance.

model_prediction.record_grain: One simulated or predicted result from a model execution; separate from a measured dose or outcome.

radiopharmaceutical_test.record_grain: One nonpatient QC, biological-reference or computational-evaluation result with an explicit subject and method.

theranostic_pair.record_grain: One evidence-supported proposed pairing of diagnostic and therapeutic agents; not an assertion of interchangeable kinetics.

external_identifier.record_grain: One reviewed external identifier assignment to one explicitly typed entity; schema-level ontology mappings remain semantic_mapping records.

radiopharmaceutical.record_grain: One reference agent in the v0.4 profile. Existing product-like records remain readable; migrate them explicitly rather than silently reinterpreting their identifiers.

radiopharmaceutical_batch.record_grain: One physical manufacturing batch; one or more timed QC results are linked through radiopharmaceutical_test.
